_meta.description: Curated gas stations along the corridor, used to seed price-tier badges when API keys aren't set. Price tier derives from brand via lib/poi/quality.ts.

entries.name: Costco Gasoline - Grand Junction
entries.blurb: Costco members only; reliably ~$0.30 below local average.

entries.name: Sam's Club Fuel Center - Salina
entries.blurb: Members-only fuel; usually cheaper than highway stations.

entries.name: Costco Gasoline - Overland Park
entries.blurb: On the south KC metro approach; members only.

entries.name: QuikTrip - I-70 KC
entries.blurb: QT cash price is competitive with members-warehouse fuel.

entries.name: Murphy USA - Columbia, MO
entries.blurb: Off I-70 exit 124; consistent low price.

entries.name: Sheetz - Pittsburgh (Penn Hills)
entries.blurb: PA Sheetz pricing is often the cheapest near Pittsburgh.

entries.name: Wawa - Cranberry Township
entries.blurb: Reliable PA Wawa; competitive price near Titusville approach.
